Core: Gold, playtime, current map, New Game, DataTable resolution

Shop: DT_Shops (32), atomic buy/sell, platinum_card, flag gating
Audio: BGM persisting across maps with crossfade, 4 volume channels

Status: 5 equip slots, conditions, Ra-Seru 1..9, elemental affinity, effective stat
Progression: XP curve, stat growth from the disc, Normal / Hard / Juggernaut
Camera: 13 presets, 8 shakes, level cameras + zones, conversation, FrameGroup / Orbit
Data: 8 DataTables as CSV, the source of truth
Mist: Living volumetric mist: 4 modes with presets, follows terrain, player trail, self light at night
WebUI: HTML SPA shell: menu, items, party, shop, save/load, options, main menu, dev screen; gamepad + keyboard + mouse, responsive scaling
Ultralight: Dedicated render thread, custom D3D11 GPU driver, shared texture
Studio: LegaiaStudio: local web panel that edits the CSVs and runs the builds
Equip UI: Equip screen — Status works, there is no UI for it
Options: Screen built; values not wired to UGameUserSettings / AudioSubsystem

Arts: Stub — directional Arts and the new AP (roadmap phase 6)

Cutscene: Nothing written; camera pieces already exist
L10n: FText everywhere + Language option; no culture switching or string pipeline
Phase 0 — Extract assets from the disc
